# onpager_oidc_group_mapping (Resource)

Manage one local OIDC-to-group mapping for an existing group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onpager_oidc_group_mapping" "example" {
  group_id      = var.group_id
  provider_slug = "primary"
  issuer        = "https://identity.example.invalid"
  client_id     = "onpager"
  external_key  = "Operations"
}

variable "group_id" {
  description = "Existing custom group UUID; each resource manages one explicit local mapping."
  type        = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Nonempty literal OIDC client ID without NUL. Case and whitespace are preserved; null and empty values are invalid.
- `external_key` (String) Nonempty external group key without NUL. Exact case and whitespace are significant and preserved. No external group discovery or membership mutation is performed.
- `group_id` (String) Custom group UUID. Changing it replaces the resource. The derived All Users group cannot be managed. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.
- `issuer` (String) Nonblank literal OIDC issuer without NUL. Case and whitespace are preserved. Must match the configured deployment binding for eligibility.
- `provider_slug` (String) Literal deployment provider slug: 1–64 letters, digits, `_` or `-`. Updates replace this mapping in place; no IdP lookup is performed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable nonzero canonical lowercase OnPager UUID.
- `revision` (Number) Independent mapping revision used in strong numeric If-Match for replacement and deletion. Parent and other child revisions are never used.

## Import

Import using `group_uuid/mapping_uuid`. The `id` attribute contains only the
mapping UUID.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_oidc_group_mapping.example
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_oidc_group_mapping.example 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
```

## Lifecycle

This resource owns one local OIDC-to-group mapping. Changing the immutable group
UUID replaces the resource. Provider slug, issuer, client ID and external key
update in place using the mapping's own strong numeric `If-Match` revision.
Parent and sibling revisions are not used. HTTP 412 requires a new plan.

All mapping strings are required. Literal issuer, client ID and external key
values preserve case and whitespace; the API imposes no additional text-length
limit. A mapping grants eligible access only when it matches the deployment's
OIDC binding and current identity policy. The provider does not contact the
identity provider or discover external groups.

Destroy deletes the mapping using its own revision. Group metadata, manual
memberships, role assignments, other mappings and identity-provider data remain
independent. The derived All Users group cannot receive mappings.

Refresh and import use the direct scoped read. Confirmed absence removes state;
authentication, authorization, transport, malformed-response and conflict errors
retain it. Mapping identifiers persist in Terraform state as configuration;
identity-provider credentials are not managed.

## Permissions

Requires tenant grants `oidc_group_mappings.read`, `oidc_group_mappings.create`,
`oidc_group_mappings.update` and `oidc_group_mappings.delete`. Service accounts
require explicit native grants.
